title: Evidence of an arm exclusion in corpus/arms.toml (`evidence` of an [[arm]] override, and validation_only_evidence)
description: Either the free-text form (`unverified`, or `indexer: <query, date, ledger range, count 0>`, kept readable for old rows) or a census reference: the census file and query that count the arm 0 over a range, and the positive control of the same query shape that counts above 0.

file.description: The census file, relative to the repository root.

query.description: query_id of the row that counts the arm.

control.description: query_id of a positive control of the same query shape.
